question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spill the beans

options.text: To be in a state of shock
To have happy period of your life

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Spill the beans"** means to reveal or disclose a secret, often unintentionally. (राज़ खोलना)

 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally** spilled the beans **about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **"Expose a secret"** means to make known something that was intended to be kept hidden. (राज़ खोलना)
 
 
• **Example:** She **exposed the secret **that had been kept for years.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To have an excuse** (बहाना बनाना): To provide a reason or explanation to justify something.

 
 
• **Example:** He always has an excuse for being late.
 
 
 
• **To be in a state of shock** (सदमे में होना): To be extremely surprised or upset.
 
 
• **Example:** She was in a state of shock after hearing the news.
 
 
 
• **To have a happy period of your life** (खुशहाल समय): A time in life when one feels very happy and content.
 
 
• **Example:** College days were a happy period of my life.

The correct answer is **Option 2**.
